title: Ask Taipei City Hall
subtitle: City-service answers, with sources
description: Search 8,000-plus Taipei city-service FAQs in your browser. Every result links back to its source; an optional model-assisted mode can summarise the answers.
longDescription: The 2017 Taipei city-government chatbot competition project, rebuilt in 2026 as a static web app. Chinese BM25 retrieval runs locally in a Web Worker and returns the issuing agency, date and source for each FAQ. An optional mode uses your own API key to summarise the retrieved material.
features: Agency, update date and original source on results
Chinese retrieval in a Web Worker
Optional answers grounded in retrieved FAQs
